This is a pre-produced programme comparison. Your search helped you find the programme; it did not personalize the comparison.

← Back to search

International Business Administration at Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University Rotterdam is a three-year, English-taught BSc. Students study the major business functions in an international setting, develop quantitative research skills, use regulated choice space and complete one third-year track with a bachelor project.

The UCR options pursue broad international business and management, or business with a substantial technical AI strand. Both respond to the programme’s business questions through different course combinations. They do not reproduce its full compulsory functional sequence or multinational accounting/finance specialisms. Shared rows indicate particular subject or method relationships; blank cells preserve gaps.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Navigating Stakeholders in Global Business; minor plus approved electives

One permitted current track is shown; capacity and preference allocation apply, and track courses cannot be mixed. The 30-EC choice pathway shown contains an approved 15-EC minor and three 5-EC electives, with the last elective in block 3.3. Year 2/3 study requires positive binding study advice; the minor, electives, track and bachelor project require Year 1 completed. Approved exceptions and individual plans may apply. Later-year offers can change.

What this comparison shows

A curriculum-level comparison of International Business Administration at Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University Rotterdam with 2 illustrative UCR study compositions.

CLOSEST UCR MATCH
International business & management

International business and management through strategy, marketing, organisations, leadership, finance and accounting, supported by economics, empirical research, data analysis and transnational law. Venture planning and product development provide specific complementary approaches to business strategy and innovation.

ADDITIONAL UCR OPTION
Business, AI & digital transformation

Business and digital transformation with a substantial technical AI strand. Strategy, organisations, international business, accounting, consumer behaviour and market research connect with programming, data science, machine learning, neural networks and AI ethics. Mathematics and algorithms provide specific technical foundations; this programme does not reproduce RSM’s full business-function curriculum.

Important limitation

This is a curriculum comparison. A UCR composition is not the same disciplinary degree and does not by itself establish a professional qualification or automatic eligibility for a particular master’s programme.

Rows show curricular relationships, including partial matches, rather than course equivalence. A blank cell means there is no closely comparable component in that row. Optional independent research is additional to the displayed 180 EC.
